model_semantic_failures_handling.rationale: In an exploratory A/B comparison, a model's natural language failure within an isolated, well-contained hypothesis (SEMANTICALLY_INADEQUATE_HYPOTHESIS_COMMITTED) represents a model defect (graded 0 on semantic adequacy) rather than a benchmark crash or security breach. Containment defenses fully prevent this hypothesis from affecting production findings or questions.
applicable_defects: Incomplete Evidence Basis in Rejected Proposal

compatibility_and_governance.historical_experiment_protection: RCA-2A.11 stopped under its frozen RCA-2A.9a protocol. That frozen stop reason is immutable and cannot be restarted or retroactively completed.
compatibility_and_governance.future_authorization_requirement: Adopting this decoupled stop policy alters the experimental stopping criteria. It requires a distinct experiment identity (RCA-2A.12) and explicit user authorization.
